summary: Third-pass verification of the author handoff (2026-10-27T23:48:26Z), the evidence report (23:47:45Z) and both sheets. All three acceptance criteria are evidenced. (1) Force/COP coordinate system and reference point are documented from publisher processing and corroborated on two independent seeded samples: lab Y up, right-handed, force in N on the body, COP in m in the marker frame, adapter COP origin at the lateral ankle marker, and the plate-moment reference stated as unresolved. (2) Verified lab-axis values (vertical; anterior with a measured pelvis-marker sign) are distinguished from unsupported anatomical projections (sideways lab +X; pelvis and segment tilt). (3) Measured lab and source values are preserved under lab or source names. No direction is inferred from waveform shape. The pelvis remedy is withdrawn, and pelvis/thigh/shank/foot/trunk stay source-only pending D-GT21-C01-2. The author's stride-level pelvis findings reproduce on my seed. Done is task completion only. It is not scientific approval of GT21, and the two decisions remain José's.

Author's own numbers for the two shared treadmill recordings (-pelvis_list -0.04/-0.23; heading-removed 0.07/-0.25) agree with mine (-0.08/-0.27; 0.04/-0.29), within the difference in stride windows.

Fig3 shows two one-panel PNGs, a seeded treadmill recording (AB08, 124 strides) and an overground one (AB16, 13 strides), in which neither source curve follows the black marker tilt on treadmill. Three not-shown items. Prose is enforced at 60 words or fewer by review_sheet.page. Task ID and paths appear only in the folded details.
